name: hangingpanda-workspace
description: HangingPanda Enterprise Software & CMS - Unified Full-Stack Architecture

scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const opts = { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }; spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], opts); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'web', 'run', 'dev'], opts);"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
